units.rawText: That's what we agreed on, right?

units.rawText: ...What?

spans.text: ...What?

units.rawText: ...It's far too unstable here!
units.displayText: ...It's far too unstable here!

spans.text: ...It's far too unstable here!

units.rawText:
My still sluggish senses caught onto the change in 416's tone, but not what dangers my surroundings hid. 
My consciousness was dragged into some type of vortex, the senses I so painfully gathered torn apart once more.

units.displayText: Commander!

spans.text: Commander!

units.rawText: Crap, if this continues, your data... Focus! Get over here!
units.displayText: Crap, if this continues, your data... Focus! Get over here!

spans.text: Crap, if this continues, your data... Focus! Get over here!

units.rawText:
What remained of my sight and hearing screamed to me that she was doing everything she could to approach me.
Between the chaotic streams of data, I could not discern which direction she was calling to me from, and could not hope to control my digitalized "hand" at will.

units.rawText: ...Commander! Grab onto my hand, and don't let the data torrents isolate you! Put your focus—

units.rawText: On me, I'm here! ...Look at me!
units.displayText: On me, I'm here! ...Look at me!

spans.text: On me, I'm here! ...Look at me!

units.rawText:
The data streams raged like a roiling storm, yet surged like a rushing body of water.
As my cognition erred on the edge of being swept away, her hand firmly grasped on, "dragging" me back.

units.rawText: —Can you stand?

I look up, a familiar Doll in front of my eyes, seemingly observing my condition.
I support myself with the paper-strewn floor, trying to shake away my dazed state.
